LESSON: RESPONSIBILITY VALUES

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian 4.5 By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to read Luke 
Topic 4.6: Responsibility Values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Responsibility Values. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Responsibility Values
2. Give Kenyan examples for Responsibility Values
3. Practise Responsibility Values at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: RESPONSIBILITY VALUES
This lesson teaches Responsibility Values for Grade 2 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Responsibility Values
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Responsibility Values
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Responsibility Values at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Responsibility Values using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Responsibility Values above.
2. Explain Responsibility Values to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Responsibility Values.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Responsibility Values with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Responsibility Values important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Responsibility Values
2. Give Kenyan examples for Responsibility Values
3. Practise Responsibility Values at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
